description: This Java class 'GenericHelperInfo' serves as a container for data source connection information within the Apache OFBiz framework. It manages properties like entity group name, helper base name, tenant ID, JDBC URI, username, and password, providing getter and setter methods for these fields.

classes.name: GenericHelperInfo
classes.description: A final class that encapsulates data source connection details, including entity group, helper base name, tenant ID, JDBC URI, username, and password, with methods to access and modify these properties.

methods.name: GenericHelperInfo
methods.description: Constructor initializing entityGroupName and helperBaseName, setting helperFullName to helperBaseName initially.

methods.name: getHelperFullName
methods.description: Returns the full name of the helper, which may include tenant ID if set.

methods.name: setTenantId
methods.description: Sets the tenant ID and updates helperFullName to include tenant ID.

methods.name: getOverrideJdbcUri
methods.description: Returns the override JDBC URI or a default value if not set.

methods.name: getOverrideUsername
methods.description: Returns the override username or a default value if not set.

methods.name: getOverridePassword
methods.description: Returns the override password or a default value if not set.
